q: What should a box maker ask its kraft paper mill for?
title: Box makers: kraft paper supplier data
short: Ask for CO2e per tonne of kraft paper for a stated year, what it includes, and how biomass fuel was treated. Kraft paper is usually the biggest line in a corrugated box's footprint, so the mill's figure decides most of yours.
audience: Corrugated box makers supplying FMCG, pharma and export customers

ul: CO2e per tonne, by grade, for a named calendar or financial year.
Boundary: mill gate only, or including waste paper and chemicals.
Fuel mix and how biogenic CO2 was reported.
Electricity source, grid or captive, and the factor used.

sections.h: If the mill has no figure
p: Ask for fuel, power and output for the year and work it out with them. Mark it as supplier data you calculated, not a published figure.
Multiply by tonnes of paper per box, including trim waste, and add your own corrugator and conversion energy.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
